items.q: Abdominal examination order that protects findings is which?
o: Inspection, auscultation, percussion, then palpation from least to most painful area last
Deep palpation first in every patient
Palpation before inspection routinely
Percussion only if palpation is normal
items.exp: Palpation alters bowel sounds and guards pain, so inspection and auscultation come first and the painful area is palpated last (standard examination teaching).

Deep first palpation provokes guarding and pain.
Inspection reveals herniae, scars and distension first.
Normal palpation does not cancel percussion value.
